details.description: DeepSeek-V3-0324 is DeepSeek's March 25, 2025 update to its DeepSeek-V3 chat model, per DeepSeek's own API changelog and release announcement. It keeps V3's Mixture-of-Experts architecture but brings, per that changelog, a significant boost in reasoning benchmarks, stronger front-end web-development code, improved Chinese writing, and better function-calling accuracy. Its Hugging Face model card lists MIT-licensed weights. DeepSeek's own changelog shows the deepseek-chat endpoint has since moved on through DeepSeek-V3.1, V3.1-Terminus and V3.2 to newer DeepSeek-V4 models.
advantages: Scores 81.2 on MMLU-Pro, up from 75.9 for the original DeepSeek-V3, per DeepSeek's own changelog.
Scores 68.4 on GPQA-Diamond, up from 59.1 for DeepSeek-V3, per DeepSeek's own changelog.
Scores 59.4 on AIME, up from 39.6 for DeepSeek-V3, per DeepSeek's own changelog.
Scores 49.2 on LiveCodeBench, up from 39.2 for DeepSeek-V3, per DeepSeek's own changelog.
Improved front-end web-development code executability and Chinese writing quality over DeepSeek-V3, per DeepSeek's release announcement.
disadvantages: DeepSeek's own changelog shows the deepseek-chat endpoint has since moved on to newer DeepSeek-V4 models, so this checkpoint is no longer served under that default alias.
Superseded five months later by DeepSeek-V3.1, per DeepSeek's own changelog.
Text only; no image or audio input or output.
use_cases: Front-end web development and code generation.
Function calling, JSON output and fill-in-the-middle code completion, per DeepSeek's release notes.

notes: Catalog's max_input_tokens (32768, 163840) and max_output_tokens (32768, 163840) were not corroborated: neither the Hugging Face model card nor DeepSeek's release notes for this specific checkpoint state a context-length figure (the architecture is the same as DeepSeek-V3, whose own docs state 128K). Hugging Face's own metadata sidebar shows '685B params' for this model, versus 671B/37B-activated stated in DeepSeek-V3's model card and GitHub README for the shared base architecture; likely a difference in whether the multi-token-prediction module is counted, so no total-parameter figure is stated in the description. No separate GitHub repository for this checkpoint was found. Release date is DeepSeek's own changelog date (2025-03-24/25); the arXiv citation on the HF card is for the original December 2024 V3 technical report, not this update.
